title: Turf Wars Trailer
author: RoutineBell9578
selftext:
Cosy Vibe ground maintenance game that slowly turns sinister, tempted to redo all models with Tripo using p2 low poly- as I have some fun ideas for characters i could illustrate. but I do actually like the current style and theres a certain charm to that rudimental look that ai generates.

Models were all created with blender MCP, i think i got lucky with strimmer model, perhaps because one session was focused just on that so it was doing iterations more as a lot of the other models were nowhere near as good, when i asked for a batch of things to do .

Animations were all originally made with astra, but it was struggling so I just asked it to use mixamo for a lot of the main ones- i think it combined its own with the mixamo ones for certain tasks.

comments.body: looks good.  Where can we try your game ?

replies.author: RoutineBell9578
replies.body: Thanks! I've not released it anywhere yet, it's still in development, but I can send you a message once its released.. still needs controller support/ device support and performance optimisations oh and some ui tweaks. Gameplay and story is all complete though, and I'm really happy with it, its pretty fun - will release on steam if I get enough interest, if not it'll be [itch.io](http://itch.io) and iOS if I can get it running well on the device
